statements.sql:
SELECT 0 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT "cid") AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN "cid" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."customers"
UNION ALL
SELECT 1 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT "hid") AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN "hid" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."headers"

SELECT
  0 as table_index,
  MIN("ts") as min_date,
  MAX("ts") as max_date
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."details"

SELECT "cid"
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."customers"
SAMPLE ROW (10000 ROWS)
WHERE "cid" IS NOT NULL

WITH TMP as (
  SELECT
    f.index as __KUMO_BATCH__,
    f.value[0]::NUMBER as __KUMO_ID__,
    f.value[1]::TIMESTAMP_NTZ as __KUMO_END_TIME__,
    f.value[2]::TIMESTAMP_NTZ as __KUMO_START_TIME__
  FROM TABLE(FLATTEN(INPUT => PARSE_JSON(?))) f
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, "ts"
FROM TMP
JOIN "{catalog}"."{schema}"."details"
  ON "cid" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND "ts" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
AND "ts" > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
WHERE "ts" <= ?
AND "ts" > ?

WITH TMP as (
  SELECT
    f.index as __KUMO_BATCH__,
    f.value::NUMBER as __KUMO_ID__
  FROM TABLE(FLATTEN(INPUT => PARSE_JSON(?))) f
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, "cid", "seg"
FROM TMP
JOIN "{catalog}"."{schema}"."customers"
  ON "cid" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__

SELECT
  0 as table_index,
  MIN("ts") as min_date,
  MAX("ts") as max_date
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."headers"

WITH TMP as (
  SELECT
    f.index as __KUMO_BATCH__,
    f.value[0]::NUMBER as __KUMO_ID__,
    f.value[1]::TIMESTAMP_NTZ as __KUMO_END_TIME__,
    f.value[2]::TIMESTAMP_NTZ as __KUMO_START_TIME__
  FROM TABLE(FLATTEN(INPUT => PARSE_JSON(?))) f
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, "hid", "cid", "ts"
FROM TMP
JOIN "{catalog}"."{schema}"."headers"
  ON "cid" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND "ts" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
 AND "ts" > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
WHERE "ts" <= ?
  AND "ts" > ?
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
  PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__
  ORDER BY "ts" DESC, "hid"
) <= 32
ORDER BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "ts" DESC, "hid"
